backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining IoT device types, sensor readings, automation rules, alerts, and user profiles with CRUD operations and access control integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (dashboard, device management, automation rules, analytics, alerts) to their corresponding files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities for the Smart Campus IoT management system.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Smart Campus Automation System React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with all routes, authentication guard, profile setup modal, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/ActionBuilder.ts: Visual builder component for creating automation rule actions with device selection, command type picker (turnOn/turnOff/setTemperature), and temperature input.
frontend/src/components/AlertCard.tsx: Card component displaying alert details with severity badge, timestamp, message, and acknowledge/delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ConditionBuilder: A form component for building and managing boolean rule conditions with device selection, sensor type, comparison operators, and threshold values. Allows adding, removing, and updating multiple conditions dynamically.
frontend/src/components/DeviceStatusBadg: Displays a colored badge indicating device status (online, offline, or maintenance) with appropriate styling for each state.
frontend/src/components/DeviceTypeIcon.t: Renders appropriate Lucide icons for different device types, distinguishing between sensor types (temperature, humidity, occupancy, energy) and actuator types (toggle, thermostat).
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with header, navigation sidebar, footer, and authentication-gated content. Shows welcome screen for unauthenticated users and full navigation for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity authentication with login/logout functionality, displays user profile name when authenticated, and manages loading states.
frontend/src/components/MetricCard.tsx: Displays a metric card with an icon, label, value, optional trend, and variant-based color styling (default, success, warning, danger).
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sidebar navigation component with links to Dashboard, Devices, Automation, Analytics, Alerts, and AI Insights pages, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup, collecting name, department, and contact information with form validation.
frontend/src/components/RecommendationCa: Displays AI-generated recommendations with category badges (energy savings, space utilization, operational efficiency), estimated impact, timestamp, and dismiss functionality.
frontend/src/components/SensorChart.tsx: Renders a line chart visualization of sensor readings over time using Recharts, displaying timestamp and value data.
frontend/src/components/SeverityBadge.ts: Displays a colored badge for alert severity levels (critical, warning, info) with appropriate styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, handling actor creation, initialization with admin token, and query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useProfile.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current user's IoT profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for devices, sensor readings, automation rules, and alerts with CRUD operations and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with a mint green and slate gray color theme using CSS custom properties for light and dark modes, including sidebar and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function `cn` that merges Tailwind CSS classes using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Alerts.tsx: Displays a filterable list of system alerts with options to acknowledge or delete them, using severity and status filters.
frontend/src/pages/Analytics.tsx: Provides device sensor data visualization with chart display and CSV/JSON export functionality for selected devices.
frontend/src/pages/AutomationRules.tsx: Displays a list of automation rules with toggle, edit, and delete functionality. Shows rule conditions, actions, and creator information with navigation to create/edit forms.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page showing campus operations overview with metric cards for device counts, online status, alerts, and system health. Includes a hero image and device status breakdown.
frontend/src/pages/DeviceDetail.tsx: Device detail page displaying comprehensive device information including status, location, type, and sensor readings with a chart visualization. Uses device ID from URL params.
frontend/src/pages/Devices.tsx: Device management page with search and status filtering capabilities. Displays all devices in a card grid with icons, status badges, and last-seen timestamps.
frontend/src/pages/Recommendations.tsx: AI insights page for displaying and managing AI-generated recommendations. Includes functionality to generate new recommendations and dismiss existing ones.
frontend/src/pages/RuleEditor.tsx: Form-based editor for creating and updating automation rules with condition and action builders. Validates rule ID, conditions, and actions before submission.
frontend/src/utils/exportData.ts: Provides functions to export sensor reading data to CSV or JSON formats with formatted timestamps and automatic file download.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended theme properties, animations, and plugin integrations for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata for a Smart Campus Automation System defining architectural notes, existing features mapped to requirements, and system design principles for IoT/AI integration.
